title: Charge-to-mass ratio
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as 2U/(B²d²).

title: Total time expression
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) must match (3√3+2π)Bd²/(12U) or equivalent simplified form.

title: Magnetic circular motion
description: Important: Must apply qvB = mv²/r to relate velocity, magnetic field, and radius.

title: Energy from acceleration
description: Important: Must use qU = ½mv² to determine initial velocity after acceleration.

title: Geometry in magnetic field
description: Important: Must correctly interpret that the chord length d corresponds to the radius of circular motion.

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: Must analyze projectile motion in electric field to find time from OP to x-axis.

title: Arc time calculation
description: Important: Must calculate time in magnetic field using circular motion period and appropriate fraction.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in electric force direction or magnetic force direction reduces score.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Check that final expressions have correct units for charge-to-mass ratio and time.
